bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
db=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | awk 'tolower($2) ~ /postgres/ {print $1; exit}')
test -n "$db" || exit 71
sql="SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='room' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL;"
room_count=$(docker exec "$db" sh -c 'PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" psql -X -A -t -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"' sh "$sql" | tr -d '[:space:]') || exit 72
sql="SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL;"
ann_count=$(docker exec "$db" sh -c 'PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" psql -X -A -t -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"' sh "$sql" | tr -d '[:space:]') || exit 73
sql="SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature IN ('announcement','room') AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL;"
gate_count=$(docker exec "$db" sh -c 'PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" psql -X -A -t -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"' sh "$sql" | tr -d '[:space:]') || exit 74
printf 'VERIFIED_ROOM_TOPIC_COUNT=%s\nVERIFIED_ANNOUNCEMENT_TOPIC_COUNT=%s\nVALID_RELEASE_GATES_COUNT=%s\n' "$room_count" "$ann_count" "$gate_count"
test "$ann_count" -gt 0 || exit 75
